title: Reported Speech: Tense and Universal Truths — Quiz 124
content:
## Reported Speech: Tense and Universal Truths

Choose the reported tense and notice when a general truth stays unchanged.

### Lesson focus

1. They said, “Honesty is the best policy.”
2. My neighbour says, “Good days will come.”
3. My neighbour said, “Good days will come.”

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
